title: Everyday Phrases — An Eye Exam
scene_zh: 眼科檢查 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hello, I need to book an eye exam.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】👓 實用眼科檢查必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — An Eye Exam
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用眼科檢查情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從電話預約、視力檢查、散瞳驗光到挑鏡框保養眼鏡，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical An Eye Exam phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from booking by phone and the vision test to dilating drops, picking frames and lens care. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to book an eye exam.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ, aɪ nid tu bʊk ən aɪ ɪɡˈzæm./
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想預約一次眼科檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we are open all week.
dialogue.zh: 有的，我們整個禮拜都開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I come in for a check?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kʌm ɪn fər ə tʃɛk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，你什麼時候方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have time Thursday morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will book it now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我現在就幫你預約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my full name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, what name should I write?
dialogue.zh: 需要，請問要寫哪個名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do you spell your last name?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju spɛl jʊr læst neɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is W, H, I, T, E.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈdəbəlju, eɪtʃ, aɪ, ti, i./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my birthday too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, what day were you born?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was born in June eighty-eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wəz bɔrn ɪn dʒun ˈeɪti ˈeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我出生在一九八八年六月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我最近看遠處都是模糊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long has it been like this?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæz ɪt bɪn laɪk ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 這樣的情況持續多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It started about two months ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, we will check your eyes.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我們會幫你檢查眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes also feel sore often.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛也常常覺得痠澀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They sting when I read long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I get headaches near my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The doctor will look at that.
dialogue.zh: 醫生會幫你看看這個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it fine to wear contacts?
dialogue.zh: 我可以戴隱形眼鏡去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me, do you wear them?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I wear them every day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take them out that day.
dialogue.zh: 那檢查當天要把它們摘下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wear my glasses instead?
dialogue.zh: 那我改戴框架眼鏡好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is better for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When should I take them out?
dialogue.zh: 我該什麼時候摘掉隱形眼鏡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take them out two hours before.
dialogue.zh: 檢查前兩小時就摘下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will leave them out.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我會先把它們摘掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 戴隱形眼鏡會讓我的眼睛乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的保險有涵蓋檢查嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I still have to pay?
dialogue.zh: 我還是得自己付一些錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，只要自己付一小部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much will the exam cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個價錢包含新眼鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不包含，眼鏡要另外加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以自己開車過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but plan a ride home.
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過最好先安排接你回去的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do I take care of payment?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn du aɪ teɪk kɛr ɪv ˈpeɪmənt?/
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候要把費用結清？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring my old glasses?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They are ten years old now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 正好，我們可以拿來對比。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I also have an old prescription.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那張單子也請一併帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is two blocks away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to fill forms?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們會寄一份到你的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will check my email now.
dialogue.zh: 我這就去查看我的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does an exam take?
dialogue.zh: 檢查一次要花多久時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will a doctor see me there?
dialogue.zh: 那邊會有醫生幫我看診嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，由李醫生幫你檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have my number on file?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv maɪ ˈnʌmbər ɑn faɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有留我的電話號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, fɔr ˈsɛvən tu, ˈeɪt wʌn naɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I need to cancel?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只要提前一天打電話即可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I am all set now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk aɪ æm ɔl sɛt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我想我這邊都確認好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，安娜，預約都完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, do you sell glasses?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ, du ju sɛl ˈɡlæsəz?/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，你們賣眼鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 賣的，我們的眼鏡店就在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, Thursday at ten in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ˈθɜrzdeɪ æt tɛn ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is right, see you then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for all your help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I wrote the time down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And bring your insurance card too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I have a ten o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And what name is it under?
dialogue.zh: 請問是登記在誰的名字下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有了，已經幫你登記報到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I just sit and wait?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the wait today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will turn one light down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I will copy it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And here are my old glasses.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I fill the form right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this one D or O?
dialogue.zh: 這個是 D 還是 O？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 再看一下，注意那個弧線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, it is a C this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ɪt ɪz ə si ðɪs taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 下面小字那幾行模模糊糊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This line: F, T, L, O.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 什麼是二零二零的視力？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many lines do I read?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 讀到你分不清的那行為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I cover the wrong eye?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒有，那一邊已經測完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這台大機器是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它可以看清你眼睛內部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part do I lean on?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my forehead on the bar?
dialogue.zh: 額頭要貼住這根橫桿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see small lights in there.
dialogue.zh: 我看見裡面有小小的光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，那個一瞬間就結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will feel a puff of air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl fil ə pʌf əv ɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 與其說是痛，更像是被嚇一跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I am ready for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is okay, we got it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is glaucoma common in old people?
dialogue.zh: 青光眼在老年人中常見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can be, so we test all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kæn bi, soʊ wi tɛst ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 有可能，所以人人都做篩檢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛現在一直流淚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 還有一項檢查，然後點眼藥水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I will stay right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doctor, will you check my eyes now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɑktər, wɪl ju tʃɛk maɪ aɪz naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 醫生，您現在要檢查我的眼睛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，我們就在這裡開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those drops going to sting?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I hold my eyes open?
dialogue.zh: 我要把眼睛撐著睜開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is common, do not worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些藥水是做什麼用的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can see the back.
dialogue.zh: 對，我能看到眼底的後方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 所有東西已經變模糊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，今天戴它會舒服些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I drive home like this?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thing my friend is here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那你的回程就沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is bright light bad for me?
dialogue.zh: 強光會傷害我的眼睛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個儀器上有好多鏡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I look through it now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那兩組看起來一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us try one more time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 鏡片喀噠喀噠地換來換去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我在一點一點微調度數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, that is your new power.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這就是你的新度數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的度數變得更差了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope that is not bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我以後要一直戴眼鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old glasses feel too weak.
dialogue.zh: 我的舊眼鏡度數好像不夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One for home, one for outside.
dialogue.zh: 一副在家用，一副出門用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these drops safe to use?
dialogue.zh: 這種藥水用起來安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use them with contacts?
dialogue.zh: 戴隱形眼鏡時也能滴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my eyes feel less dry?
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛會比較不乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 針對乾燥還有別的辦法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do I hold it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my phone making it worse?
dialogue.zh: 是我的手機讓情況變糟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I look at work screens all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʊk æt wɜrk skrins ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我整天都盯著公司的螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有沒有什麼簡單的規則？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每二十分鐘就把目光移開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 看二十英尺，持續二十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它能讓疲勞的眼睛休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I dim my computer screen?
dialogue.zh: 我要把電腦螢幕調暗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 換大一點的螢幕有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stop screens at night?
dialogue.zh: 晚上我該完全不碰螢幕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, do I need new glasses?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我還能繼續戴隱形眼鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要常讓眼睛休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So nothing is wrong with me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 記得滴人工淚液多休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they have my prescription there?
dialogue.zh: 樓下的店有我的驗光單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they got your notes already.
dialogue.zh: 有的，資料已經傳給他們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你好，我要配一副新眼鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 醫生已經把你的資料傳來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I choose a frame?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 先試試這些，我們有很多款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like these thin black ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have the same in brown?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ðə seɪm ɪn braʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 同樣的款式有棕色的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我覺得棕色看起來更柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these frames plastic or metal?
dialogue.zh: 這些框是塑膠還是金屬的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 金屬摸起來涼涼的、很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不過塑膠戴起來比較溫潤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的皮膚比較適合塑膠框。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These keep sliding down my nose.
dialogue.zh: 這副一直從我鼻子往下滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a clear frame?
dialogue.zh: 你們有透明色的鏡框嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take the brown pair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, you look great in brown.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，您戴棕色很好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們有三種不錯的鏡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have blue light ones?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 它們真的能保護眼睛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很多人覺得眼睛比較不累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的鏡片可以做更薄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, thin ones cost a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, θɪn wʌnz kɔst ə bɪt mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，薄的要再加一點錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth it if they look nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hard coat helps a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個亮亮的選項是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那是防眩光，夜間開車有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want that, sun and clear.
dialogue.zh: 我要那種，能變深色變透明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the full set?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that with the thin lenses?
dialogue.zh: 那個價格包含薄鏡片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 包含，一共一百八十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that is over my budget.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這超過我的預算了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, let us sign you up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I sign my name?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, when can I pick up?
dialogue.zh: 簽好了，我幾時可以取鏡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you call me when ready?
dialogue.zh: 做好了會打電話給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 會，我們傳簡訊或打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, I am here for my glasses.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ, aɪ æm hɪr fər maɪ ˈɡlæsəz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, Ms White? They came in today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ, mɪz waɪt? ðeɪ keɪm ɪn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 啊，懷特小姐？今天剛送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, may I try these on now?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, meɪ aɪ traɪ ðiz ɑn naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我可以先試戴一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try them, how do they feel?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, so clear! But the floor looks far.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, soʊ klɪr! bʌt ðə flɔr lʊks fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 哇，好清楚！不過地板看起來好遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New lenses do that, it fades.
dialogue.zh: 新鏡片常這樣，會慢慢適應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我鼻子這裡被夾得有點痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The arms feel a bit tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now they fit my head well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I clean the lenses?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以用衣服袖子擦嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不行，一般布會刮傷鏡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I keep them at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ kip ðɛm æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 晚上我要把眼鏡放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the case, off the bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave them somewhere hot?
dialogue.zh: 可以把眼鏡放在悶熱的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, not in a hot car.
dialogue.zh: 不行，別留在曬熱的車裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In six months, we check again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New glasses get an early check.
dialogue.zh: 新眼鏡要早一點回診檢視。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are set, see you then.
